faculty: Faculty of Applied Health Sciences Technology (East Port Said National University)

overview.text: Prepares scientifically and practically distinguished specialists in modern health technology through applied programs combining scientific knowledge with laboratory and healthcare-institution training. Focuses on graduates who support the healthcare system while following quality, occupational safety and healthcare ethics standards.

vision.text: Preparing specialized and scientifically and practically distinguished professionals.
vision.source: https://epnu.edu.eg/en/faculty-of-applied-health-sciences/ (live page, via WebFetch summary; the local page 1047 has no explicit vision statement)

mission.text: Improve community healthcare by graduating competitive applied-health professionals, supporting a learning and creativity-focused environment, and producing research that serves society through technology and knowledge.
mission.source: https://epnu.edu.eg/en/faculty-of-applied-health-sciences/ (live page, via WebFetch summary; wording is a summary, not verbatim)

facilities.item: Specialized teaching laboratories, including medical laboratory labs equipped for different medical analyses
Training in microscopy, biochemistry, hematology fundamentals and microbiology
X-ray, CT and MRI devices for training in the Medical Imaging program
Equipped classrooms, e-learning tools and digital learning resources

three_slide_bullets: Two applied programs: Medical Laboratory Technology and Medical Imaging and Radiologic Technology.
Study is conducted in English over 131 credit hours.
Clinical training partners include Port Said University Hospital and Saudi German Hospital Cairo.
Labs cover microscopy, hematology, biochemistry, microbiology, and X-ray, CT, MRI training.
Program director: Dr. Salma Khairallah, PhD in Biochemistry, Port Said University.
